body.message:
Hi,

I’m looking for accommodation starting from 29 August, ideally for the first 6 months.

Could you please let me know the total cost for this accommodation, including all bills, taxes, and any other fees?

I’ll be relocating from Germany to Dubai for work, so I also wanted to ask whether I would need an Emirates ID to rent the apartment, or if my passport would be sufficient initially until my Emirates ID is issued.

Also could you please send me more pictures or videos of the accommodation, including the gym, pool and any other facilities available?

Thank you! I look forward to hearing from you.
